overview_description.description:
Roomstorm (Formerly WalkSource)  is a next generation Business-to-Business network for hoteliers looking to run operations more efficiently and generate more revenue. Roomstorm empowers revenue teams to have more sellout nights by taking in last minute guest relocations from other nearby hotels as well as airlines in need of housing guests overnight. 

Roomstorm proudly services over 400 Bay Area hotels and continues to grow with the recent edition of our first airline partner, San Francisco based Virgin America. 

Our hotel partners confidently overbook their properties, exchange lower priced guests for higher priced ones, find good deals for a relocated guest end-to-end within 5 minutes. By eliminating the pain of dealing with a relocations, we make the market much more efficient.

product.name: Hotel Guest Relocation Service
product.description: A service that arranges alternative hotel accommodations for guests who need to be relocated due to overbooking, maintenance, or other disruptions.

product.name: Distressed Passenger Accommodation Service
product.description: A service that provides immediate hotel accommodations for passengers affected by travel disruptions such as flight cancellations or delays.
